name: Jointeca Education Solutions Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2001, Jointeca Education Solutions Ltd provides Enterprise Application Solutions and Integrated IT Solutions in 
the field of Education.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JESL is an education service provider primarily focused on delivering ERP solutions in publications, manufacturing, and school management, mainly operating in Northern India. The company has expanded into the Skill Development sector, offering industry-relevant training programs to equip individuals with practical competencies.
